clusters.name: After Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around four months after Bea's birth you can see Lena worn out and on edge, then Paul and Lena pulling into distance by November 1995, your stomach aches and missed school by February 1996, shouting matches between Paul and Jonah by May 1996, and Lena not going back to her job by September 1996, all within about a year and a half of the new baby arriving, suggesting the family's balance was disturbed around Bea's birth.
